title: Top-dimensional component reduction for intersection positivity
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $X$ be a nonempty proper $k$-scheme [def-weil-proper-morphism] of dimension $d$, and let $\mathcal L$ be an ample invertible sheaf [def-sc-invertible-module] [def-sc-ample]. The top self-intersection number $(\mathcal L^d\cdot X)$ is the sum, with positive generic multiplicities, of the corresponding intersection numbers on the integral irreducible components of $X$ having dimension $d$ [def-pc-integral-scheme]. Consequently, positivity of those integral component numbers implies $(\mathcal L^d\cdot X)>0.
